text.en: Pet owners consistently highlight the warmth, patience, and clinical knowledge of Dr Gass and the veterinary technicians. Reviewers appreciate that the team takes time to answer questions and never rushes through consultations. Although one client was dissatisfied with practice management regarding prescription approvals, most praise the attentive and empathetic bedside manner shown to every pet.

Clients frequently observe how calmly and patiently staff members interact with nervous dogs and cats during exams. Several reviewers note that their pets, including rescue dogs and skittish breeds, felt relaxed and comfortable during procedures such as nail trimming and routine check-ups. Owners express strong trust in the team's kind and soothing approach.

Reviewers share contrasting impressions regarding service charges and clinic fees. Several clients appreciate upfront pricing and state that the practice avoids unnecessary procedures, keeping routine veterinary care fair and transparent. Conversely, one client reported frustration over pharmacy policies and price differences for prescription medications.

q.en: Does Culebra Creek Veterinary Hospital accommodate drop-in visits?

a.en: Yes, clients report that the clinic accommodates same-day drop-off appointments for urgent health concerns when schedule slots allow.

q.en: Can pets receive nail trims and grooming at the facility?

a.en: Yes, the practice offers grooming services and nail trims alongside veterinary medical exams.

q.en: Are veterinary costs and estimates explained in advance?

a.en: Most pet owners state that staff provide clear estimates before procedures, though prescription medication pricing policies drew mixed feedback.

q.en: Does the hospital treat both dogs and cats?

a.en: Yes, the medical team provides preventive examinations and treatments for feline and canine patients.
